Hair Restoration Cork

Hair restoration,
backed by evidence.

Hair loss is personal — and treating it properly starts with understanding the cause. Our hair restoration programme in Cork begins with a full consultation and trichoscope assessment, looking at medical history, lifestyle, medications and scalp health.

From there, your nurse builds a personalised plan using proven approaches — PRP therapy, exosomes, scalp microneedling and red light therapy — alongside blood testing to identify contributing factors like iron status, thyroid function and hormones.

  • PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) therapy for thinning hair
  • Exosome treatments for advanced regeneration
  • Scalp microneedling with red light therapy
  • Hair health blood monitoring for men and women
